title: Micron's Cyclical Trend Could Burst in the Long Term

Micron's Cyclical Trend Could Burst in the Long Term By 0
Micron Technology, Inc. (MU) has been a typically cyclical stock in its history, but some more bullish analysts and investors think there is a case to be made that the company can break its persistent mold in the long term.
"The demand is going to be there in the long term," Susquehanna Financial associate Nicholas Ghattas told Real Money in an interview. "Hyperscalers like Apple, Inc. (AAPL) , Amazon.com, Inc.
